<pre>
Ramon benchmark for Z3
-
Job description: QF_NRA: eager=true, aeq=false. Compare vs eager_off_QF_NRA (run 30680370791).
Job tag: eager_on_QF_NRA
Runner: rise-runner-1
Z3 repo: Z3Prover/z3
Z3 commit: 9a94c951506fe702f1461d0562bc664c6837faef
Z3 branch: nla-aeq
Z3 options: "-T:60 -st smt.arith.nl.propagate_linear_monomials_eagerly=true"
Z3 inputs: https://zenodo.org/records/16740866/files/QF_NRA.tar.zst?download=1
Z3 commit message: Record the defining row of a linear monomial unconditionally

propagate_linear_bound marks a monic propagated as soon as is_linear
holds, but propagate_nonfixed declined to add the defining row m = k*w
whenever the current model happened to satisfy it. Model agreement is
transient, the propagated flag is not, so the relation ended up recorded
nowhere: the monic reappears in m_to_refine as soon as the model moves
and the only handle left on it is refine_pseudo_linear, which turns the
same fact into a case split and re-derives it on every final check.

On FStar-UInt128-1-reduced-core.smt2 j128 is fixed to 2^32 by bounds, so
j240 := j128 * j233 is linear, yet no row was installed; the trace shows
the identical nla-pseudo-linear lemma derived three times.

Add arith.nl.propagate_linear_monomials_eagerly (default true) to install
the row regardless; setting it to false restores the previous behaviour.

On the F* regressions (serial, 10 seeds) this is x0.71 on seeds 0-9 and
x0.97 on seeds 100-109, and turns failedQueries-FStar.Math.Euclid-2 and -3
from unknown into unsat (12s -> 0.3s / 0.16s), as well as
regressions/higher-order/variant1-generic-lambda.smt2. FStar.Matrix-2
crosses its own rlimit of 2500000 (1.60M -> 2.58M) and reports unknown; it
still solves in 1.4s with the rlimit lifted.

93/93 unit tests pass; 1266 regression files over nl, smt2, issues,
bounded_q, higher-order, qsat, verve, mcsat_smt2, smt2-debug/extra/chc,
poirot, subterms and Everest show no soundness conflicts.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
